findings.claim: The new handoff paths are relative to the skill directory, but appear inside the generated architecture document. From the documented output openspec/project/architect/final.md, ../project-inception/SKILL.md resolves to openspec/project/project-inception/SKILL.md, and the role-chain path has the same problem. Consumers following these paths cannot reliably reach the intended skills. Use repository-root-qualified skill locators or explicitly identify their resolution root.
proof_refs: The added template line supplies ../project-inception/SKILL.md and ../role-chain/SKILL.md inside the architecture output outline.
The rewritten SKILL.md preserves openspec/project/architect/final.md as the file output location.
The supplied contract identifies the intended skills under skills/project-inception/ and skills/role-chain/.

evidence: Statically inspected all ten changed paths through the complete supplied canonical diff against S1–S9 and both lens rows.
